title: Small cap Snapshot: Anteris expands trial, PilbaraGold expands mineralsiation and more...
summary: Here’s a look at some of the small-cap companies in the news this Wednesday. Anteris Technologies has expanded its pivotal PARADIGM Trial across active sites in the United States, Canada and Europe, while also securing regulatory clearance in Germany and advancing activities in Australia. The company has also moved into a new Minnesota facility to support increased production of its transcatheter heart valve ahead of commercialisation. Third-quarter net operating cash outflows were US$22.9 million. Nova Minerals has confirmed around 216,000 tonnes a year of processing capacity at its planned Port MacKenzie hub in Alaska, with modelling pointing to potential refined antimony production of up to 20,000 tonnes annually.
